statusLabel: Supported, Not New — debuted in Burst Protocol
summary: Elfnote is NOT a Chaos Origins original — it debuted roughly 9 months earlier in Burst Protocol. CORI adds new support that completes the archetype's game plan. Level 6 Spellcaster monsters of varying Attributes plus Synchro Monsters, built around shuffling monsters through the Center Main Monster Zone and pairs well with a Synchron sub-engine.

cards.name: Elfnote June Pride
cards.effectText: New in CORI. Can return itself to the Extra Deck during your Main Phase to Special Summon up to 1 Elfnote monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY (once per turn). Widely described as the card that 'completes' the archetype.

cards.name: Elfnote Regina
cards.effectText: Starter piece — can Special Summon itself under the right conditions and adds any Elfnote monster from the Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Elfnote Fortuna
cards.effectText: Places a card referred to as 'Rhapsodia of Madness,' can Special Summon itself from the GY, and can negate a face-up card on the field.

cards.name: Elfnote Power Patron
cards.effectText: Raises Elfnote Regina's Level, which is what enables Elfnote June Pride's Synchro Summon.

cards.name: Medius the Pure
cards.effectText: Cross-archetype tutor target shared with Artmage and DoomZ — a card can Special Summon it from hand or Deck if you control an Artmage, DoomZ, or Elfnote card.

comboLines.title: Center Monster Zone shuffle into June Pride
comboLines.body: Elfnote's signature play is cycling monsters through the Center Main Monster Zone to set up Synchro Summons. Use Elfnote Power Patron to raise Elfnote Regina's Level to the right number to Synchro Summon Elfnote June Pride, then bounce June Pride back to the Extra Deck on a later Main Phase to reload up to 3 more Elfnote monsters from hand, Deck, and GY.

sampleDecklist.label: Established archetype with real post-Burst-Protocol ladder data, now updated with CORI's June Pride support — more mature than the brand-new CORI archetypes, but this specific 40 is still a community/ladder build, not a verified NAWCQ Top Cut list.
